related.title: NIST 囚禁離子：紅藍邊帶溫度計
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付RF／世俗時間尺度圖、無量綱q表及穩定性證據缺口。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver RF/secular timescale diagrams, dimensionless q tables and stability-evidence gaps. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『NIST 囚禁離子：紅藍邊帶溫度計』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付邊帶積分表、非線性反算曲線及有效域標記。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'NIST trapped ions: red/blue-sideband thermometry', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver integrated sidebands, nonlinear inversion curves and validity-domain markers.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：在a≈0、小Mathieu q時ωsec≈qΩRF/(2sqrt(2))；這是穩定區內近似，未包含雜散場微運動。 使用教學q=0.2、ΩRF/(2π)=20 MHz；結果為fsec=ωsec/(2π)。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2*20/(2*sqrt(2))，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用ωsec/ΩRF=q/(2sqrt2)作無量綱檢查；再比較小q假設，不外推q=2。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：熱分布且弱探測時紅藍邊帶比R=Ired/Iblue=n̄/(n̄+1)，所以n̄=R/(1−R)。 使用合成積分紅邊帶0.2、藍邊帶1.0，R=0.2；先不加入飽和效應。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2/(1-0.2)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：反算R=n̄/(n̄+1)還原兩比例；把R=1列為發散界線，R>1不是有效熱平衡解。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a≈0 and small Mathieu q, ωsec≈qΩRF/(2sqrt(2)); this stable-region approximation excludes stray-field micromotion. Use Teaching q=0.2 and ΩRF/(2π)=20 MHz; output fsec=ωsec/(2π). Evaluate nominal expression 0.2*20/(2*sqrt(2)) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless ωsec/ΩRF=q/(2sqrt2); retain the small-q condition rather than extrapolating to q=2.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a thermal distribution under weak probing, red/blue ratio R=n̄/(n̄+1), hence n̄=R/(1−R). Use Synthetic integrated red sideband0.2 and blue1.0 give R=0.2; saturation is initially excluded. Evaluate nominal expression 0.2/(1-0.2) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Invert R=n̄/(n̄+1) for both cases; R=1 is divergent and R>1 is not a valid thermal solution.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: QuEra 光鑷：光束腰寬與捕捉強度尺度
related.titleEn: QuEra optical tweezers: beam waist and trapping-intensity scale
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付RF／世俗時間尺度圖、無量綱q表及穩定性證據缺口。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

related.difference: 建立『QuEra 光鑷：光束腰寬與捕捉強度尺度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付強度積分、焦點敏感度與極化率資料需求。

Outcome: Deliver intensity integration, focus sensitivity and polarizability-data requirements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：在a≈0、小Mathieu q時ωsec≈qΩRF/(2sqrt(2))；這是穩定區內近似，未包含雜散場微運動。 使用教學q=0.2、ΩRF/(2π)=20 MHz；結果為fsec=ωsec/(2π)。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2*20/(2*sqrt(2))，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用ωsec/ΩRF=q/(2sqrt2)作無量綱檢查；再比較小q假設，不外推q=2。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：Gaussian峰值強度I0=2P/(πw²)，w為1/e²強度半徑；勢阱深度還需要極化率與失諧。 使用教學單鑷P=1 mW、w=1 μm；強度以MW/m²表示，不作雷射操作設定。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：對Gaussian截面積分應還原1 mW；若漏掉係數2，總功率將錯一倍。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a≈0 and small Mathieu q, ωsec≈qΩRF/(2sqrt(2)); this stable-region approximation excludes stray-field micromotion. Use Teaching q=0.2 and ΩRF/(2π)=20 MHz; output fsec=ωsec/(2π). Evaluate nominal expression 0.2*20/(2*sqrt(2)) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless ωsec/ΩRF=q/(2sqrt2); retain the small-q condition rather than extrapolating to q=2.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Gaussian peak intensity I0=2P/(πw²) uses1/e² intensity radius w; trap depth also requires polarizability and detuning. Use Teaching single-tweezer P=1 mW and w=1 μm; express intensity in MW/m², not as a laser operating prescription. Evaluate nominal expression 2*0.001/(pi*(1e-6)**2)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Integrate the Gaussian profile to recover1 mW; omitting factor2 gives a factor-of-two power error.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
